title: Vacaciones — describí y compará
goals: Meta declarada por el material: describir tus vacaciones y una ciudad, comparándola con otras.
Aprendé los lugares de una ciudad, sabé pedir y dar direcciones, y dominá comparativos y superlativos.
Cerrá contando adónde fuiste, qué viste y cómo era ese lugar comparado con el tuyo.

atoms.narrative: Hello, my name is Katia. Last February I went on holiday to the south of France with two friends. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. It was cheaper than the big hotels in the centre, and much quieter. Every morning we walked along the sea and had coffee in a café on the corner. The weather was colder than we expected, so we visited a lot of museums. The best day was when we took a train to a little village in the mountains. It was the most beautiful place I have ever seen.

atoms.prompt: Imagine you went on holidays. Write about what you did, the places you visited, what you liked or disliked, and describe the city. Use linking words.
atoms.modelAnswer: Last summer I went to Córdoba for a week. First, I arrived by bus on a Sunday morning and I stayed in a small hotel in the centre. Second, I visited the old Jesuit block and the cathedral, which is the oldest building in the city. I also walked around the market and took a lot of photos. The city is smaller than Buenos Aires and much quieter, but it is more crowded in the centre than I expected. I liked the food because it was cheaper than at home, but I did not like the heat: it was hotter than in Buenos Aires. Finally, I went to the mountains and that was the best day of the holiday.
modelVariants: Two years ago I went to Bariloche in winter. First, I travelled by plane and stayed in a hostel near the lake. The town is much smaller than my city and far more beautiful, because you can see the mountains from every street. I visited the chocolate shops on the main avenue and I went skiing for the first time. It was more difficult than I thought, but also the most exciting thing I did. The worst part was the cold, because it was colder than I expected. Finally, I bought presents for my family and I came back very happy.

blocks.text: Dear James, this vacation is wonderful. I arrived by ship to the island. The island is beautiful and the weather is hot and sunny every day.

I arrived on Saturday morning and I went to Agios Sostis beach. I took a long swim and then I sunbathed until noon. Next, I had lunch at a tavern on the beach. Also, I met some boys from Romania and we played volleyball with some of the local people. They are all very friendly.

In addition, I loved the hotel because it is fantastic, very modern, and it also has a pool. I liked the town, I walked around and took some photos. Then, I went to Delos to visit the ancient ruins. Finally, I went shopping yesterday and I bought you a nice present.
I hope you like it. See you when I get home. Love, Helen.
